newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ net public debt falls to 29.3 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: NZ net public debt falls to 29.3 pct of GDP.

text.p: New Zealand's net public debt as a percentage of GDP has broke below 30 percent for the first time since the March year of 1982-83, Treasury said on Friday.
As a percentage of GDP, net public debt was 29.3 percent at November 30, 1996 against 31.7 percent at June 30. It peaked at more than 51 percent in 1991-92.
Net public debt, at $26.5 billion, was $239 million (0.9 percent) lower than forecast and $2.1 billion (7.4 percent) below net public debt at June 30.

Treasury said the significant reduction in net public debt since June 30 was principally due to proceeds from the sale of Forestry Corporation of New Zealand, coupled with the net cash flows from operations over the past five months.
